author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs cross-platform First Five placements using Twitch/Kick rewards and Viewer Foundation points on YouTube/TikTok, with one placement per viewer per stream.
changelog: 4.1.75: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.75, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.0: added queue-skipping redemption safety, offline reward deactivation, controller-confirmed stream resets, clearer monthly leaderboard separation, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.0: initial release with one serialized five-place reward chain, stable Twitch user-ID enforcement, automatic per-stream reset, weighted monthly rankings, winner announcements, optional hosted leaderboard cards, and a separate two-action Streamer.bot companion package.

manifest.name: First Five
installationSteps: Import the separate First Five Streamer.bot package.
Keep its Controller action triggerless and approve only that action for this add-on.
Keep Twitch and Kick Reward Redemption attached to your existing main platform actions.
Choose five Twitch IDs and five Kick IDs in placement order. The saved YouTube, TikTok and Facebook command registers automatically after restart.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its compact leaderboard state remains preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that place claims are handled one at a time, rewards move to the next place, and the monthly leaderboard is saved.
